test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

An afternoon performance of a play, film or show
solution:
The correct answer is '**Matinee**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Matinee**__- **A musical or dramatic performance or social or public event held in the daytime and especially in the afternoon.**

 __
 
• ** ****E.g.**__- The Saturday** matinee** was so crowded that we had to sit in the second row.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is '**Matinee**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Exhibition**__- **A collection of objects, for example, works of art, that are shown to the public** (प्रदर्शनी) 

 __
 
• **​ E.g.__**- The photographs will be on **exhibition** until the end of the month.
 
 
 
• __**Circus**__- a show performed in a large tent by a company of people and animals.
 __
 
• **E.g.**__- We noticed a poster advertising a **circus**.
 
 
 
• __**Musical**__- Interested in or good at music(संगीत-प्रेमी या संगीत-निपुण)
 __
 
• ​E.g.__- He’s very **musical**. ** ****​**
